customManagers.description: Upstream bases as tag@digest: the preset's comment manager only tracks versions, which would miss same-tag rebuilds (Debian fixes)

packageRules.description: Test Dockerfiles build FROM python:${PYTHON_VERSION}-...; the version comes from PYTHON_BASE_IMAGE
Each Python variant stays on its own minor (the preset already disables python minors/majors; this keeps patch lookups per variant)
